name: Mina's Cooking
source:
Mina's cooking is a point-and-click visual novel game; help Mina host a stream and cook dishes for her viewers, but don't screw up, otherwise Mina may lose popularity and support. 

Protect Mina from haters and find the recipe for the most delicious secret dish!

[i]Be careful in the kitchen![/i]

[From [url=https://bentocode.itch.io/minas-cooking]itch.io[/url]]
